changeLog.change: Added WALLET-ORDER-R01–R04 and G01–G04. Reused existing transactional wallet checkout; clarified its UI and added minimal authenticated payment options. Demo wallet spending was found disabled despite sandbox funding; activation will use the approved setting workflow. Other launch and import holds are preserved.

Registered the read-only HTTP endpoint with private/no-store caching. Real PostgreSQL and browser checks passed. Demo wallet spending was enabled using an audited owner request; no direct database change or Paystack mode change occurred. Native installed-app interaction remains in the denominator.

First full CI: native passed; web 742/743 passed with one obsolete purchase-credit error assertion in ER-13. Corrected that assertion to the stable insufficient-funds code and current wallet text; retained and reran all discount/inventory rollback assertions successfully. Full rerun remains pending. Installed iOS sign-in/gas navigation verified; native checkout acceptance remains unverified.
